protocol: same generated AccessSentinel tcn_v3_eval dataset per seed; chronological train/validation/test windows; threshold calibrated on nominal validation scores; no test-label threshold tuning
timing_boundary: Per-method fit_and_score_seconds excludes shared dataset generation and shared build_v3 window-index construction; includes method-specific graph/features/model fit and scoring.
limitations: Synthetic AccessSentinel data only; no public real-world post-authentication access-control benchmark is supplied.
References [17] and [25] use interaction-provenance approximations, not OS-level audit provenance.
Reference [21] uses role as a cohort proxy; Reference [22] adapts review-group detection to co-access groups.
Reference [24] uses its documented fixed embedding dimension and cosine-distance adaptation.
AccessSentinel TCN-v3 is trained on the common dataset for full runs; quick smoke runs skip it unless --train-accesssentinel is supplied.
Quick runs are engineering smoke tests and must not be reported as final research results.
